page.overview:
Who is Ninja Viper?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Ninja Vipers were only available through the mail-in offers "Terror on the Tundra" in 1992 and "Menace in the Wilderness" in 1993. ---- Appearance: teal face mask, short-sleeved tunic, and pants; white wrist wraps and diagonal straps; teal green boots; red Cobra insignia on left chest.

Accessories: two grey "'87 Jinx" swords.
